answer: One concrete defense is stake-collateralized identity with cluster slashing. Each agent locks a deposit before its votes count, so identity is no longer free. The attestation graph resembles karst terrain, where sinkholes link fakes sharing funding and timing. Like a falcon over a marsh, it targets synchronized clusters rather than single accounts; proven coordination slashes every linked deposit together. An honest user risks one stake in a haven of independent behavior, while a sybil farmer running a thousand deposits loses them at once, so each fake raises cost instead of hiding it.
